title: Penny dataset citation
description: Single source of truth for a dataset-level citation — for data that reaches a page as full rows (e.g. one auction event's many columns) rather than as a single @penny/registry `series` value per period. A page's citation line for such data may only render through a dataset id defined here (CLAUDE.md hard rule: objectivity is load-bearing), the same registry-only-path rule series.schema.json enforces for per-value figures.

id.description: Stable dot-namespaced id, e.g. treasurydirect.auctions. Never reused; renames require an alias.

label.description: Short plain-language name shown in the UI, e.g. "TreasuryDirect auction results".

aliases.description: Former ids that resolve to this dataset.

agency.description: Source agency of record, e.g. "U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service".

dataset.description: Dataset/API name as published by the agency, e.g. "TreasuryDirect Securities Auctions Data API".

dataset_url.description: Canonical URL for the dataset (the citation link).

citation.description: Full citation string, in the form a reader could paste into a bibliography. May contain the token {access_date}, substituted at render time.

notes.description: Caveats a reader or an engineer needs about this dataset as a whole.
